categories.main_business_segments: Saia, Inc. operates primarily through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Saia LTL Freight, as a leading less-than-truckload (LTL) carrier. Over 96% of revenue is derived from LTL freight transportation, with additional offerings including non-asset truckload, expedited, and logistics services across North America. The company operates as a single integrated segment focused on LTL services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Saia relies on a network of 191 owned and leased facilities, a modern fleet of approximately 6,200 tractors and 20,800 trailers, and significant investments in technology for operational efficiency, safety, and customer service. The company utilizes advanced scheduling, asset tracking, accident avoidance systems, and digital platforms to optimize linehaul, pick-up, and delivery operations. Technology investments also support environmental initiatives and compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Saia serves a broad range of customers shipping freight between 100 and 10,000 pounds, including manufacturers, distributors, and retailers across various industries. The company targets customers requiring regional and national LTL services, as well as those needing expedited and logistics solutions. No single customer accounts for more than 5% of accounts receivable, reflecting a diversified customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: Saia provides direct LTL services in 45 U.S. states and extends coverage to Canada and Mexico through third-party interline partners. The company has a strong presence in the South, Southwest, Midwest, Pacific Northwest, West, and Northeast, with ongoing expansion into new markets and increased terminal density in existing geographies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Saia operates as a downstream transportation provider, delivering finished goods and products from shippers to consignees. The company is positioned at the distribution and delivery end of the supply chain, consolidating and transporting LTL shipments between origin and destination terminals.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding geographic reach and terminal density, investing in fleet modernization and technology, enhancing safety and environmental performance, and improving operating efficiencies. Saia emphasizes organic growth, best-in-class service, pricing discipline, and sustainability initiatives such as alternative fuels and emissions reduction. R&D efforts focus on operational technology, safety systems, and environmental impact mitigation.
categories.revenue_model: Saia generates revenue primarily through the transportation of LTL freight, with pricing based on shipment weight, distance, and service level. Additional revenue streams include fuel surcharges, non-asset truckload, expedited, and logistics services. The company negotiates rates with customers and implements general rate increases as market conditions allow.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Saia competes with large national LTL carriers (such as Old Dominion Freight Line, XPO, and others), regional LTL providers, truckload carriers, small package carriers, railroads, air freight companies, and third-party logistics providers. The company is positioned as a leading national LTL carrier with a reputation for high service quality, extensive geographic coverage, and ongoing investment in technology and infrastructure.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Saia reported $2.8 billion in revenue and $470.5 million in operating income, reflecting a 22% year-over-year revenue increase and a 40% increase in operating income. The company has demonstrated strong growth through pricing actions, network expansion, and increased business mix, with significant capital expenditures supporting future growth. Saia maintains a robust balance sheet and liquidity position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Saia differentiates itself through reliable, high-quality LTL service, on-time delivery, low claims rates, and a strong focus on safety and customer satisfaction. Investments in technology, fleet modernization, and environmental sustainability enhance its value proposition. The company’s non-union workforce, flexible operations, and commitment to continuous improvement further support its competitive advantage.
